comparison.law: pure deterministic strict weak ordering; negative, zero, positive signs
comparison.directionReversal: compare signs; never negate the result

stableSort.ownership: mutable borrow of caller-owned values and initialized scratch; inline-copyable elements only
stableSort.scratch: scratch length must be at least values length; insufficient scratch fails before mutation
stableSort.success: values sorted stably; scratch prefix unspecified; both owners, lengths, and capacities preserved
stableSort.elementCopies: O(n log n) into caller-owned initialized scratch

binarySearch.precondition: sorted by the same Ordering direction and Comparison
binarySearch.ownership: readonly generic slice plus borrowed needle; binarySearch retains a literal-friendly copyable-needle wrapper
binarySearch.result: first equal index, otherwise insertion index; found flag

readonlySequence.needle: explicit ref T for every boundary/search method except the copyable compatibility wrapper
readonlySequence.elementSupport: copyable and noncopyable elements; no element is copied, moved, allocated, or retained
readonlySequence.bounds: half-open EqualRange [start, end); duplicate values retain their complete contiguous range
readonlySequence.comparisons: isSorted O(n); every bound/search operation O(log n)

merge.precondition: both readonly slices are sorted by the same Ordering direction and Comparison and do not overlap output
merge.result: Result<Int, MergeError>; success count equals left length plus right length
merge.failureTransactionality: all validation completes before the first output mutation
merge.ownership: readonly caller-owned inputs plus mutable borrow of caller-owned preinitialized output; inline-copyable elements only
merge.stability: equivalent elements retain source order and left equivalents precede right equivalents
merge.success: writes only output prefix count and preserves every owner, length, and capacity

noncopyablePermutation.requiredPrimitive: satisfied by values! -> exchange(left, right), preserving the same array owner, length, capacity, and exactly-once drop state
forbiddenWorkarounds: copying an owned element into a temporary
take plus reallocation or order-changing push

partitionPoint.semantics: readonly true*false* predicate partition; first false or length; O(log n); zero mutation and allocation

partitionInPlace.semantics: unstable true-prefix partition; one forward scan; exact typed block evaluation; atomic noncopyable exchange; O(n); O(1)

iteratorTransforms.result: current-input result emitted by the focused verifier and embedded into the General result

selection.bounds: lower and upper follow Ordering direction and Comparison
